title: Rancho Del Rio

services.name: River Gear Rentals
services.desc: Need gear to run the river? You can rent it through the Colorado River Center at Rancho. The River Center has gear for half-day, full, or multi-day adventures. The gear includes rafts, duckies, paddles, and pfds. If going overnight, you can rent drybags, river tables and toilet systems. The Colorado River has several sections you can run. Depending on the run, several end at Rancho.
